verdict.rationale: Dropbox publishes a documented public API (DBX Platform) with Files API, webhooks, OAuth, and official SDKs in multiple languages, plus GitHub repos with working code samples — enabling programmatic, AI-agent-style access. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec found (404s on openapi.json/docs.md) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs/SDK repos.
